newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals' firm to steady on festival buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals' firm to steady on festival buying.

text.p: Indian metals' prices were firm to steady on Thursday owing to a multitude of factors including festival buying, dealers said.
Ready copper rose by 50 rupees to 11,700 rupees per quintal on speculative interest and recovering world markets.
It was up by 50 rupees on Wednesday. "Nickel on the other hand attracted higher physical support from the stainless steel industry ahead of festivals," one broker said.
Ready nickel rose by 200 rupees to 37,800 rupees. Aluminium was steady at 7,250 rupees. So were zinc, lead and tin.
